dna.opening: a clay mascot drops into a dark studio mid-fall, squashes on landing and smiles while the hook reads "Your website has moods"
dna.bigMoment: a mint glass hex shield draws itself round the scared clay mascot and red bot sparks burst on it while the mascot turns mint and determined
dna.ground: plum-black studio with a key light and floor pool that change colour with the mascot mood, dust and bokeh at three depths, grain and vignette
dna.music: playful soft electronic with plucks and a bouncy bass, tension in the bot section, a riser into the shield and a warm resolve, about 112 BPM
